deities.name: Setrimir
deities.rationale: Awakened ceramic-and-wood bodies are a clear expression of artificial life created without enslavement.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Ishtanora
deities.rationale: The donated story is fired within a hearth-centered birth rite, linking new life to home and village continuity.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Marduthor
deities.rationale: Ceramic firing, woodcraft, and deliberate construction make Marduthor an important maker-patron.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
